settings.headline: Three ways
settings.subtitle: Most people join online in about three minutes. If you would rather talk to a person, we are happy to help.

items.title: Join online
items.text: Pick a tier on our membership partner's secure site. Your member login arrives within one business day.
items.label: Open the join form

items.title: Talk to us first
items.text: Questions about tiers, group insurance or the low-income rate? The membership team answers within two days.
items.label: Contact membership

items.title: Come to an event
items.text: Most chapter events are open to everyone. Meet members, then join on the day with your chapter lead.
items.label: Upcoming events

items.q: Do I need my own garden plot?
items.a: No. About a third of members garden at home, on a balcony or at a school. You just need to care about growing food in shared places.

items.q: What is in the member library?
items.a: Toolkits, legal templates, insurance guides and recordings of every members-only webinar. Members sign in on this site to open them.
Choose the option on the join form and enter any amount, including zero. Members on this rate get exactly the same benefits.

items.q: Can our garden join as a group?
items.a: Yes. The Garden Group tier covers up to 25 named gardeners at one site, adds group insurance and gives you a listing in the chapter directory.
Memberships do not auto-renew unless you ask them to. If you want a refund in the first 30 days, write to us and you will get one.
